vacancyList.postName: Assistant Statistical Officer in A.P. Economics & Statistical Subordinate Service

howToApply: Visit the Commission’s website https://psc.ap.gov.in and register via One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) to obtain an OTPR ID (if applying for the first time).
Login to the Commission’s website using your registered OTPR ID and password.
Click on ‘Online Application Submission’ and then click ‘Fill Application’ against the relevant notification number.
Fill in all application-specific data such as Local/Non-Local status, qualification details, post preferences, examination centre, etc.
Click ‘Save & Submit’ to proceed to the payment gateway.
Pay the application processing fee (Rs. 250/-) and examination fee (Rs. 80/-, if applicable) online via Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card.
On successful payment, the application is finally submitted and a payment reference ID is generated with an SMS alert to the registered mobile number.
Download the filled application PDF for reference.
Corrections in the application will be allowed up to 7 days after the last date of submission, on payment of Rs. 100/- per correction (except for Name, Fee, and Age Relaxation fields).
